concept.subject: Laundry drying on a washing line across the face of an old town house: white sheets, a gray cloth and a pair of jeans hang between its windows, over a balcony and a striped awning, with a cable crossing the sky and a tiled roof in the corner.
concept.composition: The house's wall, seen from below, fills the left two thirds; its eave runs from the top a third of the way across down to the right at about two fifths of the height, and blue sky fills the upper right. One washing line crosses the whole picture at a little under half the height, rising to the right. Slanted windows sit above it, a balcony with an iron railing and a striped awning below it; a cable crosses the sky from the top center down to the right, and a dark tiled roof fills the lower right corner.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 141. The clothespins along the washing line are spaced wide, so a ball drops through instead of riding along; a row across the middle of the tall sheets and a row along the hems hang below them, and the jeans are two legs of pegs. The windows are peg frames, the thin wire across the wall a row, the drain hole and a stain single pegs; the balcony's slab, its railing and the awning's edge are rows, and pegs follow the roof's edge and the building's corner against the sky. The window lintels and the eave are solid ledges and the cable is a rod, so the pegs nearest the cannon sit sheltered under them. Nothing reaches into the flippers' swing.

difficulty.note: Late in the stage: the pegs nearest the cannon sit under the lintels, the eave and the cable, and the middle row of the laundry hides behind the clothespins and the hems.

background.prompt: A photo looking up at the plastered face of an old town house with laundry drying across it. The wall fills the left two thirds; its eave runs from the top edge at about a third of the width down to the right, reaching about 0.73 of the width at 0.43 of the height, and plain blue sky fills the upper right. One washing line crosses the whole picture, from the left edge at about 0.45 of the height rising to about 0.4 at the right edge, hung with white sheets, a gray cloth at about 0.15 of the width and a pair of jeans at about 0.4, down to about three fifths of the height. Slanted windows sit above the line: a big one at the left edge, one at about a third of the width near the top and one with an open shutter beside it. Below the line a balcony with an iron railing spans from about 0.22 to 0.57 of the width at two thirds of the height, a striped green awning slopes down under it to near the bottom, and two dark windows stand right of it. A thin cable crosses the sky from the top center down to the right, and a dark tiled roof fills the lower right corner, its edge rising from about 0.66 of the width at the bottom to the right edge at about half the height.

picture.title: Outdoor laundry hanging on lines against an Italian building with blue sky.
picture.author: Anastasiia Lopushynska
